subject.title: fix(cron): pass allowEmptyAssistantReplyAsSilent from cron executor for both runner paths

question: Should OpenClaw treat empty assistant replies from all isolated cron agent runs as intentional silent success, and should this PR be the canonical landing branch for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94224?
rationale: The code change is mechanically sound, but accepting empty output as success for delivered cron jobs changes existing failure/status semantics and overlaps with other open policy variants.

options.title: Accept all-cron silent success
options.body: Land this executor-boundary PR as the canonical fix, then close the competing PRs and linked issue once merged.

options.title: Narrow the policy first
options.body: Request a revision that gates the flag on `delivery.mode === "none"` or a maintainer-approved per-job option before merge.

options.title: Defer the behavior change
options.body: Keep current empty-response failures until maintainers decide the broader silent-cron product contract.

recommendation.title: Accept all-cron silent success
recommendation.body: Land this executor-boundary PR as the canonical fix, then close the competing PRs and linked issue once merged.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent commits in both the cron executor area and the CLI silent-reply flag contract, making them the strongest routing candidate from the observed history.
